name: io.github.domondi1/inferrail-web-read
title: Inferrail Web Read
description: Web pages as clean markdown for $0.002 each over x402: hosted, or local with your wallet.

environmentVariables.name: INFERRAIL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Inferrail workspace key (irw_...) with prepaid credits, funded once by card or USDC. Pays $0.002 per delivered page without a wallet.

environmentVariables.name: INFERRAIL_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to INFERRAIL_API_KEY: private key (0x...) of a wallet you control holding a little USDC on Base. Without either key, calls answer 'not paid'.

environmentVariables.name: INFERRAIL_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Most the server pays per UTC day (default 0.10). Calls past it are refused before anything is signed.
